answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Accredited hotel general manager appointment with hoteliers association attestation flips the bet — an appointment the association renews after hotel inspections — and the knoll lands on the attacker instead. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the signal of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The yarrow is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
